THE WORD FOUNDRY

Maren stands in an abandoned foundry. Three workshop clues teach six words of power, element, and form, and only valid triples known to her can rouse the crucible.

Loading the engine...

Discover words

With Look (or Use) selected, click Bellows, ColdHearth, and PatternBook on the workshop floor. Each clue teaches two words onto the Foundry Lexicon board as Knows facts without naming any recipe.

Combine three words

Click Combine words (C), or select Use and click the Crucible, to pick a Power, Element, and Form from the words Maren has learned. You can also press Enter to type commands such as words or combine forge ember bolt.

Zero-leak refusal

Trying an unknown word or combining an unlisted triple such as Spark + Ember + Bolt refuses cleanly and writes zero facts to the world, so wrong guesses cannot probe or alter the crucible.

Walkthrough

  1. Look at Bellows, ColdHearth, and PatternBook until all six words light up on the Foundry Lexicon board.
  2. Click Combine words (C) and try Spark + Ember + Bolt: it fizzles with zero state change.
  3. Combine Forge + Ember + Bolt to kindle the crucible, then Spark + Water + Ward to quench it.

Keys

  • C: open the 3-word combiner on the Crucible (1/2 pick words)
  • W: show learned words and Crucible state
  • Enter: open the command bar (Tab completes words)
  • S: advance one proof step automatically
  • R: rewind to tick 0
  • I: state inspector (see Knows, Glowing, and Tempered facts)
Runs entirely in your browser on the BeSpoke Engine, a simulation engine for systemic and narrative games. The whole game is in this one file; nothing is downloaded or tracked.
